DIV8.HEAD: § 900.1 Applicability.
DIV8.P: (a) This part applies to each owner or operator of a widget furnace.
(b) The Administrator may waive any requirement of this part.

DIV8.HEAD: § 900.2 Notification and recordkeeping.
DIV8.P: (a) Each owner or operator shall submit to the Administrator an annual report of total widget furnace emissions for the preceding calendar year.
(b)(1) The owner or operator shall maintain records of each furnace startup and shutdown for at least 5 years.
(2) Records required by paragraph (b)(1) of this section may be kept electronically.
(i) Electronic records must be retrievable within 2 business days.
(ii) The owner or operator shall notify the Administrator by facsimile within 24 hours of any furnace malfunction.
(c) Each owner or operator shall submit an initial notification of construction on or before June 1, 1985.

DIV8.HEAD: § 900.3 Annual reports.
DIV8.P: (a) The owner or operator of a widget furnace shall submit to the Administrator an annual report of the total emissions from each widget furnace for the preceding calendar year.
(b) Foreign-national operators shall file Form W-9 with the Immigration and Naturalization Service.
(c) Reports shall be signed by a responsible official.
